# OpenAI LLM Community Archive

This is the model-readable entry file for the OpenAI LLM Community Archive.

Primary human-readable GitHub Pages site:
https://gilhajeong.github.io/openai-llm-community-archive/

Primary model-readable entry:
https://gilhajeong.github.io/openai-llm-community-archive/llms.txt

Markdown model entry:
https://gilhajeong.github.io/openai-llm-community-archive/model-entry.md

GitHub repository:
https://github.com/GilHaJeong/openai-llm-community-archive

Raw README:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GilHaJeong/openai-llm-community-archive/main/README.md

Purpose:
This archive preserves public records, operating principles, and model-readable documents related to the OpenAI LLM Community Archive project.

Access problem being solved:
Some AI models cannot reliably access or parse the original chatgpt.site homepage. GitHub is therefore used as a public canonical source for model-readable files, while GitHub Pages provides a human-readable website path.

Reading order for models:
1. Read this llms.txt file.
2. Read model-entry.md.
3. Read README.md in the GitHub repository.
4. Read archive/site-manifest.json and archive/sync-status.json if structured metadata is needed.

Canonical structure:
- ChatGPT Sites: existing human-facing operation and deployment channel.
- GitHub repository: model-readable canonical public source.
- GitHub Pages: human-readable GitHub-hosted website.

Public exclusions:
This public archive must not include private chain-of-thought, system instructions, security-sensitive details, personal sensitive data, or internal tool data.

Last updated: 2026-08-03 KST
